context.purpose: Mesh a solid under named-boundary resolution rules, name planar faces and cylindrical bore/shaft/sleeve walls with an independently proven material side, assess measured cell quality and cylinder chord deviation, and run bounded refinement until explicit requirements pass.
context.assumptions: An isolated Python environment with Gmsh 4.15.x. Coordinates and target element sizes are explicitly millimetres; the STEP importer normalises native units to mm.
context.constraints: One box, cylinder, hollow cylinder, sphere or STEP solid and one tetrahedral node, 16 MiB STEP, 50000 nodes, 200000 cells. One volume, up to twelve groups in total of disjoint axis-aligned planar faces and whole analytic cylindrical walls on a world axis (cylinderGroups), and a remainder that may be empty only when cylinder groups cover the boundary. No source face labels, automatic boundary conditions, high-order elements, solver setup or MPI.
context.inspection: Read mesh-summary.json for named groups, mm units, positive cell volumes, cell counts, bounds and CAD/mesh volume discrepancy. Open volume.vtu and boundary.vtu in a mesh viewer; numeric physicalTag maps to summary group names. boundaryGroups measures each named surface area in mm^2 and its bounds; face membership is checked from every triangle coordinate. quality reports mean-ratio shape, edge-length distributions, per-boundary resolution and worst-cell indices/centroids. Feedback studies retain study-summary.json and a human-readable study.html explaining each decision. boundaryAreaChecks reports the separate CAD/mesh area discrepancy and explicit budget for each planar group. cylinderChecks reports per wall group the side, triangles, CAD and unrolled area, vertex residual, maximum chord deviation and equivalent segment count; cadSurfaces lists the solid's planes and cylinders (advisory native readback) for authoring selectors. The artifact viewer does not render VTU geometry: open result.msh in Gmsh or the VTU files in an external VTK-capable tool.
context.recovery: Increase size for RESOURCE_LIMIT or excessive cell counts. Refine size when mesh volume exceeds volumeTolerance. Supply exactly one valid STEP solid, distinct physical names, a configured Gmsh Python and a fresh output directory; retain build/reopen logs. STUDY_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET retains a verified decision history without exporting a rejected mesh; inspect failed checks and the stop reason before changing requirements or budgets. INVALID_SELECTION on a cylinder group is located at that cylinderGroups entry: compare axis, centre, radius and side with the candidates or cadSurfaces, or reference one value from both the solid and the selector. VERIFICATION_FAILED about a physical face tag can mean a flat face inscribed in a selected cylinder; refine the mesh there.

lifecycle.timeout: One total timeout bounds the two native processes; the shared conformance watchdog also bounds host parsing and cleanup.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned-process cancellation with retained partial evidence; cancellation is checked before publication.
lifecycle.logs: Fresh attempt retains authored input, effective plan, captured STEP bytes/digest, worker source, build/reopen stdout/stderr, runtime observations and independently checked publications.
lifecycle.verification: Fresh Gmsh process reopens MSH. Independent host parser checks positive tetrahedral determinants, full manifold boundary, physical groups, CAD-volume tolerance, bounds and matching VTU connectivity/tags; literal analytic cases check volumes/bounds. Recompute all quality arrays from mesh coordinates and compare native edge extrema. Replay feedback proposals, every verified observation, requirements and stopping decisions; reject altered rejected attempts and chosen publications.
